d: The Knicks defeated the Raptors, 112-108 tonight in Toronto. Karl-Anthony Towns contributed a team-high 28 points to go with 17 rebounds 3 assists and 3 three pointers, with Jalen Brunson of the Knicks adding an additional 28 points (9-22 FG, 3-6 3P) in the game. Scottie Barnes finished with a team-high 30 points along with 9 rebounds for the Raptors in the losing effort. The Knicks improve their record to 7-6 with the win, while the Raptors fall to 5-8 for the season.
